description: Named import-boundary registry (T05 contract matrix rule 2). Each boundary declares a canonical module scope and the adapter/harness modules it must not import — forbidden reverse dependencies. Data, not code: tools/authority/check_import_boundaries.py reads this and enforces it.

boundaries.name: wrp-core-no-harness
boundaries.rule: Canonical WRP core (nexus_core/wrp) must not depend on the harness-construction layer (nexus_core.harness). T05 contract matrix: WRP state and harness construction are distinct concepts; wrp is canonical for the former, harness for the latter.

boundaries.name: wrp-core-no-tackle
boundaries.rule: Canonical WRP core (nexus_core/wrp) must not depend on the tackle adapter layer (tackle.agent_scheduler_runner, tackle.harness). tackle adapts the canonical harness/lease/replay interfaces; a reverse dependency would create a cycle.

boundaries.name: nexus-core-no-adapter
boundaries.rule: The canonical nexus_core layer must not depend on adapter/service layers (conduit runtime, tackle, Vision/LOSM, voyager). T05 contract matrix rule 2: everything other than the canonical owner is an adapter or projection; adapters depend on the core, never the reverse.
